## gitshift list

List all configured Git platform accounts

### Synopsis

List all configured Git platform accounts with their details.

The output shows the alias, name, email, platform, and additional information for each account.
The current active account is marked with an asterisk (*).

Displays accounts from all platforms:
- GitHub (github.com and GitHub Enterprise)
- GitLab (gitlab.com and self-hosted)

Examples:
  # List all accounts
  gitshift list

  # List in table format
  gitshift list --format table

  # List in JSON format
  gitshift list --format json

```
gitshift list [flags]
```

### Options

```
  -f, --format string   Output format (default, table, json) (default "default")
  -h, --help            help for list
```
